description: AM35 DPI button setter (set_dpi_button) uses RACE raceId 0x30EA. Param enabled encoded as bool-lookup-u8 at offset 6 with lookup {true:24, false:0}. Value 24 (0x18) is the special encoding confirmed by AM35_EVIDENCE section 5 and disassembly/AM35model.dis set_dpi_button. RACE framing: [0x05, 0x5A, length_le_u16, raceId_le_u16, ...params]. No request checksum. Getter 0x30EB returns res[9] parsed as bool (parsers.json am35-dpi-button); parser bool kind treats non-zero (including 24) as true.

samples.comment: true encodes as 24 (0x18) per AM35 special encoding

readback.comment: readback byte at offset 9 is 24 (0x18); parser bool kind treats non-zero as true
